title: Inference
description: The engines a machine uses for a knowledge base: the providers it reaches, and the provider and model each job and each Librarian actor is done with. A knowledge base's repository may carry several, one for each provider, and a machine chooses one.

spec.description: The providers, and the engine for each job and each Librarian actor.

providers.description: Each provider an engine names, and how it is reached.

engines.description: The engine each job is done with when software does it, and the engine each Librarian actor asks.
